basics.name: Emad Mahmodi
basics.label: Senior Software Developer & Reverse Engineering Researcher
basics.summary: A results-driven Senior Software Engineer and Reverse Engineering Researcher with 10+ years of experience in high-performance computing, automotive embedded systems, and AI-driven cybersecurity. Proven expertise in firmware analysis (TriCore, PowerPC), binary de-obfuscation, and the integration of LLMs with automated diagnostic tools. Published researcher in reputable journals with a focus on anomaly detection and system security.

interests.name: Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity: Leveraging LLMs and RAG for automated binary analysis and firmware documentation.
Binary Reverse Engineering: Analysis of automotive ECUs (ISA reconstruction, Seed/Key bypass, checksum extraction).
Data Science & Anomaly Detection: Predictive modeling for high-frequency data streams and trust computation in recommender systems.
Embedded Systems Security: Anti-debugging, obfuscation techniques, and hardware-level vulnerability research.

work.name: Negar-Khodro
work.position: Senior Software Developer & Lead Reverse Engineer
work.summary: Architected ECUProg v2: Developed a comprehensive automotive programming platform using C++17 and Qt 6. Optimized memory footprint by 49% and reduced JTAG overhead by 62%.
highlights: Firmware Reconstruction: Led the reverse engineering efforts for TriCore (Infineon) and PowerPC (VLE) architectures. Reconstructed logic for diagnostic services (UDS/KWP2000).
Tuning & Remapping: Designed 'Negaremap', a native Persian remapping platform featuring automated table identification and checksum correction algorithms.
Automation: Authored custom plugins for Ghidra and IDA Pro to accelerate binary analysis of automotive firmware dumps.
High-Performance Computing: Optimized matrix operations using SIMD (AVX2/SSE) and template meta-programming for real-time sensing data.
Embedded AI: Ported road-mapping inference models to NVIDIA Jetson Nano using OpenCL for GPU acceleration.

work.name: NIUniverse
highlights: Vulnerability Research: Audited diagnostic tool protection layers, bypassing anti-debugging and V-table obfuscation for integrity analysis.
System Programming: Developed high-speed communication drivers for PC-to-hardware interfacing.

projects.name: Bajaj MSE2 ECU Reverse Engineering & Security Audit
projects.description: Extracted firmware via JTAG/Bootloader and performed line-by-line disassembly using IDA Pro.
highlights: Reconstructed the Fault Management logic (sub_2B2C) and DTC generation thresholds.
Identified vulnerabilities in the Seed/Key security handshake (Service 0x27) by mapping XOR/bit-shift operations.

projects.name: PISAD ECU Full Simulator (PowerPC)
projects.description: Created a virtual environment to execute and debug PPC-based ECU dumps without physical hardware.
highlights: Implemented register monitoring and real-time state analysis for security bypass verification.

projects.name: LLM-Assisted Reverse Engineering Research
projects.description: Developing a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline to map assembly code snippets to high-level functional descriptions.
highlights: Fine-tuning open-source LLMs to identify standard automotive diagnostic patterns in raw binary code.

projects.name: Locomotive GT26 Control System
projects.description: Designed a real-time state machine in C++ to manage engine parameters and safety interlocks.
highlights: Developed a high-speed data acquisition system using FPGA-to-PC shared memory communication.
